name: SVG Studio
tagline: Give your vectors a little motion.
description: Draw shapes and paths, organize reusable symbols, keyframe properties, and export vector artwork or rendered animation.
features: Paths, shapes, text, image imports, and layers
Reusable symbols, effects, and timeline keyframes
SVG artwork plus GIF, video, and PNG sequence rendering
start: Create a canvas, draw a shape, switch to Animate, and add property keys before opening the render preview.
formats: SVG, PNG sequences, GIF, and available video codecs
limit: SVG imports support a defined subset of SVG. Check imported artwork before exporting.

name: Animated Paint
tagline: Brushstrokes with a life of their own.
description: Paint with procedural brushes that move over time. Explore built-in recipes or write and share your own JavaScript brush animations.
features: Procedural ink, particles, ribbons, and animated accents
Layered paintings with image layers and custom brush recipes
Live brush playground and animation export
start: Create a canvas, choose a brush, draw a stroke, and play the animation. Open Playground to edit a brush recipe.
formats: Brush JSON, GIF, video, and PNG sequences
limit: Custom brush JavaScript should come from a trusted source. Video formats depend on available codecs.

name: Drawing Canvas
tagline: A quiet place for your next idea.
description: Sketch and paint with pressure-sensitive brushes, layers, selections, fill, and perspective transforms in a focused raster workspace.
features: Ink, pencil, marker, airbrush, and flat brush presets
Layers, blend modes, fill, shapes, and selections
Resize, skew, perspective, and portable project backups
start: Create a canvas, choose a brush, and make your first mark. Add a layer to keep your next idea separate.
limit: No PSD or Procreate import. Stylus pressure needs a device that supplies pointer pressure.

name: FrameByFrame Animation
description: Draw cels, shape exposure timing, compare onion skins, and generate guided line-art in-betweens locally.
features: Raster drawing with layered cel timelines
Exposure timing, onion skins, and looping playback
Guided in-betweens and image sequence import/export
start: Open the bouncing-ball study, scrub the timeline, and change a drawing’s exposure. Create a new shot when you are ready.
formats: PNG, sequence ZIP, GIF, MP4/WebM, and project JSON
limit: The guided in-between tool works on line art. Audio tracks and camera animation are not included.

name: Cel Restoration
description: Clean up cel-shaded stills, adjust palettes and chroma colors, then trace the result into SVG artwork.
features: PNG, JPEG, and WebP source artwork
Palette and chroma controls for flat-color restoration
Vector tracing and scaled raster export
start: Create a project, drop in a flat-color still, adjust restoration settings, and export SVG or PNG.
limit: Designed for flat-color cartoons. Photos and gradients can become color bands.

name: Live Character
tagline: Build a character. Find its personality.
description: Assemble 2D artwork, build meshes and bones, pose with IK controls, and animate layer transforms and mesh deformation.
features: Artwork layers, subdivision meshes, and bone weights
Rotation controls and two-bone inverse kinematics
Transform and mesh animation with PNG/GIF export
start: Try the starter rig, switch to Animate, and drag a hand control at a later frame to make a new pose.
formats: PNG, GIF, and editable character JSON
limit: No Live2D or Spine runtime export. GIF uses a white background; PNG supports transparency.

name: 3D Reference
tagline: Find the pose. Frame the story.
description: Arrange figures, props, image planes, and GLB models; pose your scene and turn its camera view into a drawing reference.
features: Articulated figures, props, groups, and image planes
GLB model import, independent cameras, and lighting
PNG export and direct transfer to Drawing Canvas
start: Create a scene, pose the figure, set the shot camera, and choose Use as reference to continue in Drawing Canvas.
formats: PNG and portable scene JSON with embedded assets
limit: Requires WebGL. Compressed or externally linked GLB resources are unsupported.

name: Anime 3D
tagline: A small shot. A new dimension.
description: Pose an original procedural character, sketch in 3D space, set a shot camera, and render a cel-shaded still.
features: One procedural character with a 15-joint rig
Held pose keys across 24 frames and world-space strokes
Independent shot camera and cel-shaded PNG rendering
start: Try First wave, inspect its three held poses, explore the camera, and render a frame.
limit: An early studio: one character, a one-second shot, held poses, and still-image export.

name: TapPilot
description: Build a phone-controlled shortcut deck for your desktop using buttons, knobs, and touch controls on your local network.
features: Editable starter decks for common creative apps
Profile editor, shared key styles, and phone interface
Explicit LAN server controls and activity logs
start: Create a starter profile, review its shortcuts, publish the profile, then start the server and connect your phone on trusted Wi-Fi.
limit: Desktop Electron is required. The current LAN remote has no pairing authentication; use a trusted private network.
